items.quote: Our additional HFC capacity expansion equivalent to 15,000 metric tons per annum of R32 remains on track for commissioning in quarter 3 FY27
items.statement: 15,000 tpa R32 HFC capacity expansion commissioning in Q3FY27
items.speaker: Nitin Kulkarni

items.quote: Our Dahej MPP debottlenecking capex is progressing well and is targeted for commissioning in quarter 3 FY27
items.statement: Dahej MPP debottlenecking commissioning in Q3FY27
items.speaker: Nitin Kulkarni

items.quote: The Chemours project is on track and expected to be completed by end June, early July
items.statement: Chemours project completion by end-June / early-July 2026
items.speaker: Nitin Kulkarni

items.quote: the net working capital is expected to be in the range of 75 to 80 days
items.statement: Net working capital of 75-80 days going forward
items.speaker: Anish Ganatra

items.quote: As we look into coming into our FY27 number that we've always said of $100 million
items.statement: FY27 revenue target of USD 100 million (passage context refers to CDMO)
items.speaker: Anish Ganatra

items.quote: we've always said that our endeavor would be to be around 50%, 60% capacity utilization this year
items.speaker: Anish Ganatra

items.quote: That would go to about 70%, 75% in the coming year
items.speaker: Anish Ganatra

items.quote: we are realistically talking about 75% to 80% is where we will get to by end of FY28
items.statement: Plant utilisation of 75-80% by end of FY28
items.speaker: Anish Ganatra

items.quote: we've always maintained that we will endeavor to do 30%
items.statement: EBITDA margin of about 30% (plus/minus 1-2%) for the full year
items.speaker: Anish Ganatra

items.quote: I would model it in the range of between 7.5%, 8.5%, 9%, not more than that
items.statement: Employee cost increase of 7.5-9% per year, not more than 9%
items.speaker: Anish Ganatra

tone.label: confident
tone.why: Management says "Specialty Chemicals growth is backed by order visibility and a robust pipeline for FY27" and maintains its margin and utilisation targets.
